hashContract.canonicalization: Decode as UTF-8, normalize CRLF and lone CR line endings to LF, preserve every other byte represented by the decoded text, then SHA-256 hash the UTF-8 result.

duplicateTimestamps.reason: Both full migration names were already applied before the timestamp-uniqueness ratchet. Preserve their immutable names and reject every new collision.

rollback.policy: Prefer reviewed fix-forward. Keep the additive relaxation during application rollback if legitimate zero-value evidence exists. Never remove or modify retained records to make rollback pass.
rollback.prerequisite: In a controlled window, begin a transaction and take ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks on supplier_credit_notes then supplier_credit_note_lines. Abort if EXISTS(total = 0) OR EXISTS(lineTotal = 0). Keep locks through any reviewed future tightening migration so concurrent zero inserts cannot invalidate the check.
rollback.allowedOnlyWhen: Both zero-row checks are false; review exact > 0 constraint SQL as a NEW migration. Preserve every other clause and all migration history. Any lock timeout or constraint failure rolls back.

isolatedApplyControls: Use the existing owned verification runtime and its exact host/database/organization guard before any DDL; do not use a live customer target or ordinary application build.
